current.request: the design misses timing at 200 MHz: improve its timing

options.title: Shorten the carry chain in the s_reg update
options.approach: In montgomery_core, restructure the s_reg update (the s_reg[1] replica to s_reg[64] path) so the 18-CARRY4 addition is split. Use a carry-save form for the accumulator, or a two-segment add with the carry registered between the halves, and resolve the carry in a final step. The W+2 clock latency, the operand ports and the regs and top components are not changed.

gain.basis_note: 18 of the 20 logic levels on the 5.59 ns worst path are CARRY4. The low end is the 0.615 ns needed to reach WNS 0. The high end assumes about half the carry delay is removed, and is capped by the 5.0 ns period. The real gain depends on the next-worst paths, which are not in the analysis.

cost.note: Carry-save changes the register structure and needs a final carry resolve. Further paths may fail once the worst is fixed (33 endpoints fail now).
cost.basis: iterations are the generator's estimate (a guess); no recorded build time, so no wall-time figure

options.title: Different synthesis and placement strategy
options.approach: Keep the RTL as it is and change only the Vivado flow: try performance-oriented synthesis and implementation strategies, for example retiming, physical optimisation and an extra post-route optimisation pass. Do not change any component. The path is carry-chain dominated and routing is 26% of its delay, so the placer has limited room.

gain.basis_note: No prior run with these settings is recorded. The worst path is 5.59 ns, mostly carry logic and 26.4% routing, so I expect a small gain. This range is a guess.

options.title: Pipeline the adder in two registered halves
options.approach: Split the 64-bit add in montgomery_core into low and high halves with the carry registered between them. Adjust the control and done logic so the W+2 clock count seen by regs is kept, for example by overlapping the high half with the next iteration. The regs operand registers and the done and counter logic are checked but not otherwise changed.

gain.basis_note: Halving the 18 CARRY4 levels removes up to nine of the 20 levels from the 5.59 ns path. The high end is bounded by the remaining LUT and routing delay. The low end allows for the added register setup.

cost.note: The overlap in the bit-serial loop needs careful verification of the cycle count and the result.
